Initial release of Viral Outliers skill for viral post research across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

- Enables searching, analyzing, and benchmarking viral outlier posts and creators on major social platforms.
- Supports generating transcripts, visual breakdowns, and remixing viral posts into new content ideas.
- Lets users create and manage competitor watchlists, schedule monitoring of profiles, and add new profiles to the database on demand.
- Provides a prepaid credit billing model, with free endpoints for trending posts and pricing.
- REST API and MCP server integrations supported; free trial endpoints require no API key.
